meta.name: Power Rangers Time Force
meta.description: The Time Force Power Rangers travel to the past to stop Ransik and his band of criminal mutants.

videos.name: Force from the Future (1)
videos.overview: In the year 3000 the evil mutant fugitive Ransik escapes the custody of the elite police force known as Time Force.
videos.description: In the year 3000 the evil mutant fugitive Ransik escapes the custody of the elite police force known as Time Force.

videos.name: Force from the Future (2)
videos.overview: Traveling back in time in pursuit of Ransik, the Time Force officers meet the distant ancestor of their former leader.
videos.description: Traveling back in time in pursuit of Ransik, the Time Force officers meet the distant ancestor of their former leader.

videos.name: Something to Fight For
videos.overview: Wes weighs his privileged lifestyle against the responsibilities of joining the Power Rangers Time Force as the new Red Ranger.
videos.description: Wes weighs his privileged lifestyle against the responsibilities of joining the Power Rangers Time Force as the new Red Ranger.

videos.name: Ransik Lives
videos.overview: Ransik kidnaps Wes and takes over a television station to announce his evil plans to the world.

videos.overview: Ransik hijacks a bus full of school children and Wes' wealthy father refuses to pay the ransom, prompting Wes to reevaluate his place in the family.
